name: print-social-media-infographics-radial-donut-chart-teal-cream
title: 'Media Infographics' with a radial segmented donut chart around a central megaphone icon
whatItIs: A teal-and-cream infographic with a large radial donut chart divided into labelled percentage segments (SMS 25%, internet 21%, TV 18%, radio 15%, news 16%, mail 5%) around a central megaphone icon, surrounded by six labelled text blocks with dotted leader lines to small device icons and a bottom icon strip.
whatItMeans: Centralised and clear; radiating labelled segments from one central icon makes many data points feel like one connected system.
techniques: Build a radial donut chart with a meaningful central icon.
Connect each segment to a text block with a dotted leader line.
Close with a compact icon strip summarising all categories.

vocabulary.definition: A ring-shaped chart showing proportional values.
A line connecting a label to its corresponding data point.
